title.en: Define the workflow before you call it agentic.
title.zh: 先定义工作流，再称它为 agentic。

subtitle.en: The strongest agentic AI conversations start with work, decisions, tools, handoffs, and accountability before architecture names.
subtitle.zh: 最强的 agentic AI 对话，先谈工作、决策、工具、交接和责任，再谈架构名称。

audience: GenAI FDE · AI solution architect · Product-facing engineer

scenario.customer: We want to build agents for our operations team. We are thinking multi-agent, maybe with tools and memory, but the workflow is still evolving.
scenario.weakResponse: We can design a multi-agent architecture with tools, memory, and routing.
scenario.reliableResponse: The agentic architecture should follow the work, not lead it. I would first map the decisions the system needs to make, the tools it can safely use, the handoffs that require a human, and the accountability model for mistakes.

principle.en: Do not automate ambiguity you have not understood.
principle.zh: 不要自动化你还没理解的模糊性。

anchor.quote: A multi-agent design can become a premature abstraction if we have not defined the decision loop.

concept.en: Premature abstraction is a mature way to push back. It says the idea may be right later, but it is too early to encode it now.
concept.zh: Premature abstraction 是很成熟的反对方式：不是说这个想法错，而是说现在把它固化还太早。

intent.en: Avoid agent hype without sounding anti-agent.
intent.zh: 避免 agent hype，但不显得反对 agent。

examples.line: An agent may be the right shape, but I would not start with the architecture label. I would start with the decision loop.

why.en: You stay open while anchoring the conversation in work.
why.zh: 你保持开放，同时把讨论锚定在真实工作上。

examples.line: Human-in-the-loop is not a checkbox; we need to define which decisions require judgment, approval, or auditability.

why.en: Not a checkbox is concise and firm. It raises the maturity bar.
why.zh: Not a checkbox 简洁而坚定，直接提高成熟度标准。

examples.line: A tool is not just a capability; it is a permission boundary.

why.en: This sounds security-aware without turning into a security lecture.
why.zh: 这句话有安全意识，但不变成安全说教。

intent.en: Start discovery with work, not technology.
intent.zh: 从工作本身开始 discovery，而不是从技术开始。

lines.line: Before we design agents, I would like to understand the work the system is expected to own, assist, or escalate.

why.en: Own, assist, escalate gives a clean responsibility spectrum.
why.zh: Own、assist、escalate 给出了清晰责任谱系。

intent.en: Separate workflow agents from dynamic routing.
intent.zh: 区分可预测工作流和动态路由。

lines.line: Some steps may need a predictable workflow agent; others may need dynamic routing. I would not collapse those into one pattern too early.

why.en: You show current agentic AI literacy without overdesigning.
why.zh: 你展示了当下 agentic AI 认知，但没有过度设计。

intent.zh: 把自主性设置成有条件的。

lines.line: Autonomy should increase only where the decision criteria, tool permissions, and rollback path are clear.

why.en: This is leadership language: autonomy tied to criteria, permission, and recovery.
why.zh: 这是领导力语言：自主性必须绑定标准、权限和恢复路径。

intent.zh: 围绕风险对齐利益相关方。

lines.line: The technical design and the operating model need to move together; otherwise the agent will outpace the organization's ability to supervise it.

why.en: You connect architecture to people management and operating readiness.
why.zh: 你把架构连接到人员管理和运营准备度。

intent.zh: 把成功定义到 demo 之外。

lines.line: A good demo proves the interaction can work; a good deployment proves the workflow can be trusted repeatedly.

why.en: The contrast is memorable and production-minded.
why.zh: 这个对比好记，也很 production-minded。

prompt.en: Practice guiding an agentic AI discovery call.
prompt.zh: 练习主持一次 agentic AI discovery call。

steps.en: The team asks for a multi-agent design before defining owners.
steps.zh: 团队还没定义 owner，就先要 multi-agent 设计。

focus.en: Use premature abstraction to slow the design down professionally.
focus.zh: 用 premature abstraction 专业地放慢设计节奏。

steps.en: The agent needs to call tools that change customer data.
steps.zh: agent 需要调用会修改客户数据的工具。

focus.en: Explain tools as permission boundaries, not just capabilities.
focus.zh: 把工具解释为权限边界，而不只是能力。

steps.en: Executives want fast autonomy, while operators want human review.
steps.zh: 高层想要快速自主化，运营人员想保留人工审核。

focus.en: Frame autonomy as a staged operating decision.
focus.zh: 把自主性说成分阶段的运营决策。
